Locked domain accounts are handled by unlocking the account in Active Directory Users and Computers (ADUC) or manually unlocking the account. The tickets show the following:

1. [INC2001395] [INC2001132] [INC2000919] [INC2001180] [INC2000408] [INC2001331] [INC2001430] The Service Desk team unlocks the account in ADUC, allowing the user to log in.
2. [INC2000876] In one case, the account is auto-unlocked by a self-service bot, indicating that automation is possible for this issue.

Automation is possible for this issue, as indicated by the "Can Be Automated" status in most tickets.
